messages:
sasha: Heads-up: saw ~2-3x latency spike on a prod shard when sequence length crossed 120->130. Looks like torch.compile + CUDA graphs path picks a different fused kernel.

 dan: Which model and hardware? can you paste the perf trace? 

 sasha: gpt-medium-ish on A100, dedicated pool. Repro on staging. Perf traces show compile-time kernel selection swapping from 'fused_attn_v1' to 'attn_bwd_slow' after the first few batches.

 sasha: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T15:04:12Z] kernel_select: observed_shapes={'batch':8,'seqlen':128,'kv_dim':1024} -> fused_attn_v1
[2026-03-12T15:04:18Z] kernel_select: observed_shapes={'batch':8,'seqlen':130,'kv_dim':1152} -> attn_bwd_slow
```

 liz: :eyes: Is KV cache involved? cudagraph captures kmem/size? In past bugs cudagraph plus dynamic kv cache resizing invalidated the fast path.

 sasha: Yeah KV cache growth at seq=128 boundary. graph capture occurs when cache size matches expected and then subsequent batches with longer seq triggers fallback. Perf-bot trace attached.

 perf-bot: Profile summary: 95p latency jumped 2.4x when seqlen>128. Kernel switch correlated with first post-capture batch. KV growth + non-uniform batch shapes present.

 ajay: I think torch.compile's graph specialization w/ shape guards could cause different kernel selection if memory layout changes. Autotuner uses observed shape distribution at compile time to pick kernels.

 dan: Quick experiment: set REDWOOD_KERNEL_FORCE=fused_attn_v1 for a run. If latency drops back it's kernel pick.

 sasha: Tried that — latency normalized but saw OOMs for some long seq cases. Fused kernel assumes packed KV layout and fails when kv buffer is growing mid-capture.

 liz: Action items:
1) Add opt-in graph-capture test that ramps seqlen 64..256 to reproduce.
2) Modify autotuner to treat 'kv_dim' and 'kv_capacity' separately from seqlen when choosing capture-time kernels.
3) Add a safety fallback that re-captures cudagraph on KV resize instead of silently using the slow kernel.

 ajay: I'll add a CI unit that runs torch.compile+cudagraph with randomized KV growth patterns and records kernel selection logs. Also adding KSEL logging flag for better traces.

 sasha: SGTM. I'll open an RFC with benchmark numbers and attach perf traces. For immediate mitigation: can we disable cudagraph capture for workloads with max_seq>120 on dedicated pool?

 dan: :thumbsup: I'll add a quick config flag on dedicated pool to disable cudagraph capture when max_seq>120 (hotfix rollout).

 perf-bot: @oncall please watch the pool; raise incident if 95p latency > 200ms for next 12h.

 liz: Also adding an integration test to simulate capture+kv-resize and assert we either re-capture or fail fast with clear logs.

 sasha: Thanks team — assigning tickets and will paste traces in the RFC. :pray:
